title: Cathay Pacific NATO Jet Interception Investigation
description: Reports indicate that an investigation found Cathay Pacific pilots selected the wrong radio frequency, leading to NATO jets intercepting the flight.

sections.heading: Investigation Findings
paragraphs: According to CNA, Cathay Pacific pilots selected the wrong radio frequency before NATO jets intercepted the flight. The South China Morning Post also reports that a wrong radio frequency by the Cathay crew led to the NATO jet interception.

sections.heading: Official Review
paragraphs: According to 巴士的報, the government has completed a review of a report on the investigation into the aircraft communication loss incident.

faq.q: What caused the NATO jets to intercept the Cathay Pacific flight?
faq.a: According to CNA and the South China Morning Post, the investigation found that the pilots selected the wrong radio frequency.
